summary: Implemented ProducerBatch state tracking for KAFKA-19012 issue where messages occasionally end up on the wrong topic. Added two new boolean fields to ProducerBatch (isInflight and isBufferDeallocated) with getter and setter methods to track batch lifecycle state. Updated Sender.java to mark batches as inflight when sent and not inflight when removed. Modified RecordAccumulator.java to add completeAndDeallocateBatch() convenience method and updated deallocate() to mark buffers as deallocated. Enhanced abortBatches() to prevent double-abort errors and avoid deallocating inflight batches prematurely. These changes enable better diagnosis of batch state transitions during message sending, which should help identify and prevent messages from being routed to incorrect topics during cluster turbulence or high-load scenarios.
